'''Jinx''' was a [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] who served in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], he was part of a task force sent to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lanteeb/Legends|Lanteeb]], ferrying [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] and [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] down to the world in an [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunship]].
